### What are Tempus AI and Personalis (PSNL) agreeing to in this acquisition?
Tempus AI has agreed to acquire Personalis, with **Personalis shareholders receiving $16.25 per share**, valuing the deal at **$1.5 billion** net of Tempus’ current ownership.
